name: Dreamer 4
summary: Dreamer 4 learns a fast, accurate world model from a fixed offline dataset and trains the policy purely inside it, reporting the first agent to obtain diamonds in Minecraft without any environment interaction during learning. The emphasis is on world-model quality and inference speed sufficient for real-time imagination, which is the precondition for applying dreaming to robots where interaction is expensive.
innovation: Offline-only agent training inside a learned model, removing environment interaction from the loop.
Architectural work on making imagination fast enough for interactive-rate rollouts.
matters: The most direct current answer to how robots might learn from logged data without hardware time.
limits: Demonstrated in simulation and games; robot manipulation results are limited. Verify before citing.
lineage: The Dreamer line pushed toward fully offline training in scalable learned worlds.
